title: Motion
label: Motion
desc: A declarative animation library for React and the DOM, with springs, gestures and layout transitions.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Install the package and wrap the tree so reduced-motion preferences are honoured.

snippets.code:
# The motion package serves both React (motion/react) and plain DOM (motion)
npm install motion

sections.title: Animation
sections.description: The animate prop states the target; initial fixes the first frame.

sections.title: Variants
sections.description: Named states live on the parent and reach every child that declares the same names.

sections.title: Gestures
sections.description: Hover, tap and drag states are props on the same motion component as the animation.

sections.title: Layout Animation
sections.description: The layout prop animates box changes caused by a render rather than by a style.

sections.title: Scroll
sections.description: Scroll position becomes a motion value that can drive any transform.

sections.title: Spring
sections.description: Springs describe physics: stiffness, damping and mass stand in for duration and easing.

sections.title: Transitions
sections.description: Timing is set once for the whole animation or one property at a time.

sections.title: Exit Animations
sections.description: AnimatePresence keeps an unmounting node alive until its exit animation finishes.

sections.title: Performance
sections.description: Keep the work on the compositor and stop React from re-rendering on every frame.

snippets.code:
import { LazyMotion, domAnimation, m } from "motion/react"

// m plus domAnimation ships a smaller bundle than the full motion component
<LazyMotion features={domAnimation} strict>
  <m.div animate={{ opacity: 1 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}>
    Loaded on demand
  </m.div>
</LazyMotion>
